payload.title: Blackwell GEMM: Thread Block Clusters, TMA Multicast, and Pair-UMMA
payload.summary: How to leverage thread block clusters for Blackwell GEMM, combining TMA multicast for efficient data sharing and 2-SM UMMA (pair-UMMA) for doubled arithmetic intensity. Part 2 of the Colfax Research CUTLASS Blackwell series.

sections.heading: 1. Introduction
sections.gist: In Part 1, we covered Blackwell's Tensor Memory and UMMA instructions (`tcgen05.mma`).

sections.heading: 2. Thread Block Clusters
sections.gist: A thread block cluster groups physically proximate SMs (e.g., on the same GPC).

sections.heading: 3. TMA Multicast
sections.gist: TMA multicast loads a tensor tile into the SMEM of multiple CTAs in the same cluster in a single operation.

sections.heading: 4. CuTe Example: GEMM with TMA Multicast
sections.gist: Multicast naturally fits GEMM tiling: each tile of operands A and B is used to compute multiple output tiles.

sections.heading: 5. CuTe Example: Pair-UMMA with TMA Multicast
sections.gist: Blackwell adds the ability for two adjacent CTAs in the same cluster to cooperatively execute UMMA.

sections.heading: 6. Conclusion
sections.gist: TMA multicast reduces global memory traffic by sharing loads among CTAs in a cluster.
